name: motion-rack-focus
title: Rack Focus
description: Tiêu điểm chuyển từ lớp gần sang lớp xa: lớp này rõ dần thì lớp kia nhoè đi.

moworks.author: takayu

options.blur: px of the soft layer (8; 2.6 on the site's frame)
options.toFar: false: focus comes to the near layers (default); true: it goes to the far ones
options.split: depth from which a layer is near (1)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-rack, written here): Two depth layers: near blur 2.6 px -> 0 while far 0 -> 2.6 px over 650 ms easeInOutCubic (12-20 frames). Demo: near 4 -> 0 / far 0 -> 4 px over 0.6-1.4 s, back over 2.0-2.8 s. Params: duration (0.65 s) · blur (2.6 px) · ease (power2.inOut).
